exempt.reason: `cargo metadata --locked` validates the shared lock against every manifest of the workspace, so its result is a function of all of them by design.

exemptTargets.reason: These tests assert the partition of the root workspace's members, so the root manifest is data of the test; the owner derives the member list into an exact roster.
These laws and censuses read every Cargo manifest or lock of the workspace by design.
The schema family validates, documents and generates every schema scope of the workspace by design; a per-scope partition of the schema registry would be needed to key them narrower.
The test reads rust-toolchain.toml as data to prove where the pinned toolchain comes from.

Recorded debt: these authored targets hash root Cargo files or whole-workspace Rust patterns although each reads one crate closure; the owner replaces the entry by the generated `cargoToolchain` group and deletes it here.

workspaceKey.en: {subject} declares the whole-workspace Rust key {keys}: a crate's key hashes its own sources, its path dependencies, its locked dependency slice, what its workspaces give it and the toolchain digest, never a root Cargo file or a workspace-wide manifest, lock, source or schema pattern
workspaceKey.de: {subject} deklariert den Rust-Schlüssel des ganzen Arbeitsbereichs {keys}: der Schlüssel eines Crates enthält seine Quellen, seine Pfadabhängigkeiten, seinen gesperrten Abhängigkeitsausschnitt, das, was seine Arbeitsbereiche ihm geben, und den Werkzeugketten-Digest, niemals eine Cargo-Datei der Wurzel oder ein Muster über alle Manifeste, Sperrdateien, Quellen oder Schemata

escape.en: Cargo path of {crate} leaves the repository

workspace.en: Cargo workspace of {crate} is not declared by any manifest
workspace.de: Cargo-Arbeitsbereich von {crate} ist in keinem Manifest deklariert
